Results.ReviewText:
This is my first pellet grill, and it’s nearly perfect. The double-walled sides and lid, with the full gasket, creates an excellent seal to stop thermal leak. The design and size are excellent, and I like having the recirculating smoke cake the chimney. The WiFi is awesome, and I’ve had no problems with any connection issues.

However, the meat temperature probe is way off, even after multiple calibration attempts. This was confirmed by my ThermoWorks Signals, thermapen, and a cheap store-branded thermometer. Further, the stainless steel shelf looks fantastic but functionally is worthless. It’s far too narrow to put food, trays, or really anything else on at all.

My last gripe is my biggest. Not because it’s a massive issue for grilling, but because it shows a lack of care and attention to detail:

The drip-tray liner doesn’t fit the drip tray. It’s not only the wrong size, it’s the wrong shape. I had ordered a pack that arrived before the grill arrived and had wondered if I bought the wrong ones. Nope! The grill came with one in the packaging that was exactly the same as I bought separately…completely the wrong size. This has been reported numerous times to Traeger and in reviews and they continue to sell and provide overpriced accessories that don’t fit the product. It shows a lack of care, and it’s a huge disappointment (and surprise) after spending thousands of dollars on an otherwise stellar pellet grill.

Trust me, buy what you can afford.  From Pro 575 on up, they are all great.  It is an investment, but well worth it. You will actually save money because you will eat out a lot less.  Finally their customer service is great. From the first time I called and I didn't understand the machine initially, the agents took their time with me and welcomed me into this community.  The agents also like to smoke themselves. And if there is any issue, you will be taken care of period.  There are various pellets you can use and most of them are great.  If you are new, start with the highest rated ones to get started.  You won't be disappointed.  Finally, check for a local authorized retailer near you. When I found this well stocked Traeger retailer, it was like I was a young 5 year old boy walking into Toys R Us for the first time. Do you remember that feeling from years ago? I cooked a whole brisket July 4th weekend. It turned out fantastic. 13 hours at 200 degrees, pulled it wrapped in butcher paper for another 5 hours at 250. I also had a pan of all day baked beans on the grill at the same time. When I pulled the brisket I turned the temperature up to 300 to finish the beans. Went in side, came back out later and pulled the beans. Best meal we ever had! Went to clean my grill the next day and the bottom left side of the exterior barrel was all bubbled up. I thought it was grease or condensation. Wiped it off and paint just came peeling off. I spent two hours on the phone with Traeger customer service and got the same pitch everyone else gets. Grease flare up, cosmetic damage, can't help you! This is wrong. How do you sell a grill for $2300.00 that cant with stand heat. I was told my cook data shows when my grill was set to 300 degrees it flared to 400 degrees. So what, the grill can be set to 500 degrees. I have owned high end grills my entire life and have never had paint peel. Now I have a 45 day old very expensive grill that has cosmetic damage I have to live with. Unacceptable, you need a better quality paint with a higher heat tolerance. My request for a new grill was denied. Don't think I can recommend Traeger!

If the grill is getting too hot by going into the 500's, it may need to be tested to determine the accuracy of the thermocouple. The best way to find out is with a completely cooled off grill. You'd want to take note of the outside temperature, then when you select your temperature and hit ignite, the grill's controller displayed temperature should be no more than 20 degrees away from the outside temperature, if it's beyond that, you would need a new thermocouple. This would also help your grills temperatures in general, if you had any issues.
With Slow Ignition warnings, for this, we would want to look at how the pellets are being fed by the auger. We would remove all parts from the grill (drip tray, heat baffle, grates) then run the grill to watch the pellet feeding process to make sure it's working right.
The Pellet Sensor we can definitely take a look at with you. We can attempt to calibrate it, and depending on when it was purchased, we could replace it under warranty if it's malfunctioning.
All newly purchased Traeger grills come with a 3-year warranty, and accessories come with a 1-year warranty.
If you have any questions and/or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out to us at 1-800-TRAEGER, and we'd be stoked to assist.

Yes my neighbors meat when cooked turns out completely different than mine both in looks and taste. Definitely not a look or taste that we desire. My entire family and friends have attended our cook outs and everyone chooses our well balanced flavor that my wonderful Traeger produces. I'm not writing this because anyone has influenced me or enticed me to do so. Smoking meat properly will leave you with the taste of spices, sauces and meat in a balanced nature. Now my neighbors results are so high in smoke flavor that you don't have that balance at all. You taste smoke with everything else not tasting the way it was intended to taste. I bought this Timberline Series 850 about 2 months ago and until now I CAN'T CONNECT TO MY HOME WIFI despite several calls to the Customer service! Luckily, I can still use it (manually) without the fancy phone/wifi connections. 

This pellet "grill" is actually a SMOKER and NOT a gas or charcoal grill replacement! Don't believe those people who claim to achieve sear marks on their steaks with this! Cleaning  before every use is also very important! Otherwise, you'll have flare ups particularly if using high temperature cooking. The paint in the back where the vents are located is already chipping after 2 uses (including the seasoning step)! This is not acceptable at all for this price range!

The smoking capability of this pricey smoker is so so. You cannot use this for creating "rushed" dinner after work! Slow day long cooking probably is where this unit shines. I ended up buying another gas grill to suit my needs (and I was dead wrong about using this pellet grill as a regular gas grill replacement!). I've been using wood chips to my natural gas grill for decades now and it worked for me. Buying this expensive "toy" was a mistake!

In summary, do yourself a favor and research carefully before venturing into the pellet grill bandwagon! Don't make the same mistake I did and review those numerous reviews about wifi connectivity issues and suboptimal paint jobs! If given another chance, I would probably buy the cheaper smoker that uses real wood chips! Goodluck!

When you see smoke coming from your hopper, we recommend following the steps we have listed here: https://www.traegergrills.com/support/smoke-coming-out-of-the-hopper

Support has been good about sending parts but doesn't seem to care beyond that.  I've even had to call back to request work orders for the repair. Results.ReviewText:
It has been just over a year since getting my Timberline 850 delivered and I am just as excited about using it today as I was then!  

The quality of the unit is solid, it looks just as good today as the day I purchased it and working great.  The D2 controller is awesome, super easy to use and the temps are maintained to within few degrees (I have tested with other thermometers).  Some have stated problems with connecting to WiFi but I had no trouble at all, first time it worked seamlessly.  I love the D2 and Wifi, I have controlled the temps of my grill from across town and getting the alerts on the probe temps has allowed me to switch to the keep warm mode within the App which has been awesome.

  I live in Ottawa, Canada and I have used my Timberline on the coldest of days (-40) with no problems at all, shovel a path to it and it has always started up and heated up with no problems at all.  It does have a cold weather start setting so it takes a few minutes longer to start.  The all around double wall construction is what made me pick the Timberline due to the cold temps and I am glad I did.  I also keep mine very clean and vacuum out the dust regularly and wipe down the inside and outside of the grill often, looks brand new still.  

Everything I cook on the grill has been exceptional, especially any type of poultry from full roast turkeys to chicken breasts or thighs, always juicy and flavourful.  I have done Prime Ribs roasts, reverse seared and the taste was superb with the right about of smoke.  Ribs have always been great and the queso dip with chorizo sausage is always a hit with guests.   

I also purchased the rib rack recently and love that I can fit a ton of ribs on it and it fits the grill nicely. I also like the orange tray I ordered with it, nice for pulling meats off and for serving outside too.

After a year+ I am very happy with the purchase and by the looks of things, this thing will last many many years as well.  Only downfall, the cover for it has began to fade and show a lot of aging, a bit of leaking too, that is disappointing.    

I would highly recommend the Timberline 850, I have been happy with the performance, size and most of all the cook results, everything is always delicious.
